messages:
Alex M.: Ship window in ~4h. Final sanity pass for v1.14.0 — need owners for version bump, changelog scrub, and security sign-off.
Jordan: On it — I'll take the version bump and tagging. Which branch should I bump? main or release/v1.14?
Alex M.: release/v1.14. Docs already edited there. Use `git checkout release/v1.14` then `./scripts/bump_version.sh 1.14.0` and push. Changelog: https://internal/redwood/changelogs/1.14.0
Sara: I'll do the changelog scrub + docs spotcheck. Will add comments on the PR (#4321) in the next 30m.
Miguel: Security quick scan done. Two low-severity dependency findings (jackson). Not blocking; filing INF-212 to track. I'll follow up with a patch PR post-release.
Jordan: Drafting the tag and release notes now. Command I'm running:
```
git checkout release/v1.14
git commit -m "bump: v1.14.0"
git tag -a v1.14.0 -m "release v1.14.0"
git push origin release/v1.14 && git push origin v1.14.0
```
release-bot: Canary started against canary-1 cluster. Expect canary pass in ~10m. Monitoring: canary/1.14.0
Alex M.: @Lucy can you run the smoke plan after the canary? Test plan is in the doc: https://internal/redwood/tests/release-smoke
Lucy: Got it. I'll run smoke and basic perf checks when canary is green. ETA ~15m.
Lucy: Smoke results: basic gen ✅, latency within 99th SLO. Found flaky rerank test `test_rerank_threshold` — skipped and filed issue #987. Otherwise green.
Sara: Docs: release notes + API migration note added. Double-checked example snippets for the new param.
Jordan: Tag pushed and release draft published. Canary health: green.
Alex M.: Final sign-offs needed: QA (Lucy), Security (Miguel), Docs (Sara), Release owner (Jordan). Reply with :thumbsup: to approve.
Lucy: :thumbsup: QA green (noted flaky test separated).
Miguel: :thumbsup: Security ok, tracking ticket INF-212 for dep patch.
Sara: :thumbsup: Docs done and linked.
Jordan: :thumbsup: Release pushed to prod in 10m.
deploy-bot: Prod deploy started by Jordan. Rollback window 20m. Monitoring on. If deploy fails auto-rollback enabled.
Alex M.: Tag me + @oncall on any regression. Otherwise huge thanks team :tada:
oncall: Monitoring looks stable so far. Small 2% traffic spike during rollout but no errors. Will keep watch for 30m.
